title: Naya5/intent parser

judgments.rationale: A genuinely working CLI: the grader ran it herself on a real input and got a correct structured intent with standing-law constraints and a world-model grounding that flagged PR #2410 as not-found. Any worker or Shawn can use it today for Layer-2 decisions. Not yet wired into any pipeline (no callers at the ref) - hence not higher.

A new exercisable capability (words-in, structured intent out), but no number moved up in a measured sense: no before/after metric on decision quality, usage count, or worker adoption. The delta is capability existence, not an observed outcome.

The strongest proof in this batch: 17/17 tests pass on the grader's re-run AND the grader exercised the real CLI end to end, observing correct classification, constraint extraction from the standing laws, and honest world-model grounding (it admitted PR #2410 was not in the model rather than hallucinating). Not a 10 because production-integration evidence (Layer-2 inside the full decision machine) is not in this change.

17 tests pin classification, weight, reversibility/stakes, reference extraction, and ambiguity behavior. Residual risk: regex patterns over natural language drift as phrasing changes, and it reads a live world-model file whose freshness it cannot control.
+1140/-0 across 2 new files. Zero modifications to existing code, zero deletions. Self-contained; nothing can break.
